founders.name: Sara Primrose
founders.bio: Sara founded Primrose Trusted Care after a decade of helping families in her community find caregivers they could actually trust. She's seen firsthand how hard it is to know who's coming into your home — and built PTC to take that burden off families' shoulders. Every provider on the roster has been personally vetted and credential-verified. When she's not interviewing new providers, Sara is most likely chasing her own kids around the yard.
